title: Distributed Caching
description: Design caching systems that scale across nodes: Redis Cluster, Sentinel, consistent hashing, sharding, and multi-region caching.
longDescription: When a single Redis instance is insufficient, distributed caching spreads data across multiple nodes. This module covers clustering, sentinel, sharding, and multi-region strategies.
whatYouLearn: Use Redis Sentinel for high availability
Apply consistent hashing for key distribution
Design cluster topologies and sharding schemes
